features.label: Service kit configuration
features.text: Choose the configuration that matches the compartment and leg setup of your current Rebound Cartilage OTS brace.

features.label: Complete parts set
features.text: Includes thigh strap, calf strap, cartilage protection straps, alligator clips, popliteal pad, hinge pad, and liners.

features.label: Maintains joint unloading
features.text: Refreshes the straps that maintain crucial joint offloading in flexion.

features.label: Anti-migration liner
features.text: Sensil calf liner captures the calf to reduce slipping and shifting during activity.

features.label: Tool-free hardware
features.text: Alligator clips and color-coded buckles snap easily into matching keyholes.

measurement: The Service Kit fits the Rebound Cartilage OTS brace regardless of size, Universal fit, 12.2 to 24 in. calf circumference. Select Right Medial/Left Lateral or Right Lateral/Left Medial to match the compartment and leg configuration of the brace already in use. No new measurement is required for a replacement kit. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
